title: Aurum Ventures — partnership angles & outbound scratch
content:
Quick context: Aurum Ventures is a mid-size VC with ~120 portfolio companies, heavy fintech focus. They recently hired a Head of Data (Elena Ramos) and have been vocal about offering value-add platform services to portfolio founders (analytics, LP reporting automation). Heard from SF meetup that they care about data residency and predictable inference costs for founders.

Goal: land a pilot that demonstrates Redwood Private (VPC) for a portfolio company use case (LP Q&A assistant + deal memo summarization) and get Aurum to include Redwood as preferred vendor for portfolio support.

Primary stakeholders to target (mapping):
- Elena Ramos, Head of Data (sponsor)
- CTO of Aurum Platform (engineering buyer) - likely prefers strong infra controls
- Ops manager running portfolio tooling (day-to-day user)
- Legal/compliance for residency/KMS questions

Key value props to emphasize:
- Private deployment option (VPC/on-prem) for LP data + HSM/KMS integrations
- Predictable unit economics via Dedicated pools and autoscaling controls (demo cost numbers vs open API)
- Rollouts & fallback for reliability (Aurum's ops team hates surprises)
- Observability: token-level cost + quality regressions tied to prompt sets

Outbound subject line variants (A/B):
A. Quick pilot idea for Aurum portfolio LP automation
B. VPC pilot to automate LP Q&A — low dev lift
C. Reducing inference cost for portfolio assistants (demo in 2 weeks)

Email draft (short):
Hi Elena —
I loved your comment at the SF Data Roundtable about helping portfolio founders with analytics. We’ve helped funds run a private LLM deployment (VPC+KMS) to automate LP reporting and deal memo summarization while controlling cost and latency. Can I share a 30-min pilot plan that shows expected costs for a 10k monthly prompt volume and a short demo?
—Maya

Call script / discovery bullets:
- Confirm pain: who currently owns portfolio tooling? how are they handling LLM workloads today?
- Security: where does sensitive LP data live? do they require HSM or customer-managed KMS?
- Scale: average number of queries per month expected per portfolio company? peak concurrency?
- Success metrics: time saved for ops, accuracy thresholds for auto-summaries, cost per 1k prompts target
- Deployment constraints: VPC only? on-prem? specific cloud accounts?

Pilot sketch (2–4 week):
Week 0: scoping + access (define dataset, SSO, KMS need)
Week 1: private control plane + model onboarding (small model + quantization)
Week 2: integrate sample app (LP Q&A UI + memo summarizer) + cost monitoring
Week 3: measure quality + tweak prompts, present ROI to stakeholders
Success criteria: 80% auto-accept rate for memo summarization OR 30% time reduction for ops + <$X per 1k tokens cost (pre-agreed).

Common objections + quick rebuttals:
Objection: "We can just use hosted APIs (OpenAI)."
Rebuttal: If your portfolio deals with sensitive LP info and you want predictable monthly costs across 120 companies, our Dedicated/VPC options give data isolation and cost guarantees + observability to prevent surprise bills.

Objection: "Integration effort is high."
Rebuttal: Start with a single portfolio company and a narrow surface (memo summarize + Q&A). We provide a sample integration and a managed runbook for first 2 weeks. Typical engineering lift: <2 engineer-weeks.

Metrics to bring to first meeting (prepare numbers):
- Latency targets for average question: 200–400ms (demo run)
- Cost comparison for 10k prompts/mo across model families + quantized variants (hosted vs dedicated)
- Estimated ops time saved: baseline 5–10 hours/week down to 2 hours/week with automation

Notes to self / open questions:
- Need to confirm Aurum's cloud (AWS org id?) and whether they want Redwood managed subnet vs customer VPC peering
- Get intro to Elena from Sofia (Sofia has a warm connection) — ask for intro template
- Check if any portfolio companies are already using Anthropic/Playground (sanity check on developer familiarity)

Todo (next actions):
- Draft 30-min pilot slide deck + cost calc (Andre)
- Ask Sofia for introduction email copy (Maya)
- Create small demo repo with memo-summarize endpoint + sample UI (tech partner)
- Open PROSPECT-342 in Jira to track outreach + decisions

Reference snippets (for deck):
- "Private deployments with customer KMS and audit logs — used by funds to keep LP data on dedicated capacity"
- "Automatic prefix caching and batching reduced token costs by ~35% on similar workloads"

Slack snippet to ask Sofia: 
"Hey Sofia — can you intro me to Elena Ramos at Aurum? short note: Redwood can run a 2–4 week private pilot (VPC+KMS) to automate LP Q&A and memo summarization for portfolio companies — demo + cost estimate ready. Will follow up with a one-pager. —Maya"

Rough outreach cadence:
Day 0: intro email
Day 3: follow-up with 1-pager + optional 15-min calendar link
Day 7: share short video demo + call to action

Endnotes: keep this doc lean — iterate after first convo. Mark anything we commit to in Jira.

-- scratch o/"
